name: The Howling Vale
summary: At the Howling Vale, worgen have overrun a ruined shrine near Felwood. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow seeks the cause of their arrival in Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Chilling Presence
sections.body: Worgen cries echo from a ruined shrine in northern Ashenvale. The shrine of Mel'Thandris lies beyond a cavern path near the Felwood border. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow fears the worgen may bring another disaster to the woodland realm. Night elf sentinels are already spending great effort holding back demonic corruption from Felwood.

sections.title: The Living Chronicle
sections.body: Melyria sends seekers to the overrun shrine to consult the Tome of Mel'Thandris. Mel'Thandris blessed its leaves to capture significant events. Opened among the hostile worgen, the tome summons a spectral vision of Priestess Velinde Starsong. The vision reveals her fateful invocation of the mysterious Scythe of Elune.

faq.q: Where is the Howling Vale located?
aliases: how to get to howling vale
where is the shrine of mel'thandris
faq.answer: The Howling Vale lies in north-central Ashenvale, just southwest of the Felwood border. A cave passage leads into the vale and to the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris.

faq.q: What are the wolf-men in the vale?
aliases: what are the monsters in howling vale
faq.answer: The wolf-men are worgen, specifically members of the Terrowulf pack. These savage, unnatural beasts walk on two legs and suddenly appeared in Kalimdor, terrorizing ruins near the Felwood frontier.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The Tome of Mel'Thandris is an enchanted relic in the shrine ruins. Mel'Thandris blessed its leaves to capture and project visions of pivotal events to those who study it.

aliases: who is the ghost in the tome
faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a night elf priestess involved in the struggle against demons near Felwood. The Tome of Mel'Thandris may reveal more of her story.
Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow asks from the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. She is troubled by demonic incursions from Felwood and the unexplained arrival of nearby worgen.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Melyria care about the shrine?
faq.answer: Sentinels in Ashenvale guard against corruption from Felwood. After wolf-men seized an ancient night elf holy site near the border, the Sentinels needed to learn whether demons were behind it or a new danger had emerged.

angles.text: As a night elf, the desecration of Mel'Thandris's shrine strikes at your duty to protect Ashenvale. The visions of Priestess Velinde Starsong bring a sorrowful glimpse of that burden.
As an Alliance member, you join the search for the origin of the terrifying worgen stalking northern Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a priest, you may find the search for Priestess Velinde Starsong a sobering tale of devotion to Elune.
